tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: A UCB shall adhere to the following instructions for charging penal charges in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: In case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be applicable from June 30, 2024.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: These instructions shall be applicable to all credit facilities offered by the UCB including cash credit, overdraft, securitisation and co-lending portfolios, etc.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: However, these instructions shall not apply to credit cards, external commercial borrowings, trade credits (rupee / foreign currency export credit) and structured obligations which are covered under product specific directions, as also other foreign currency loans.
